Transfer implementation in domain:
public State transfer(Step step, State post) {
  if (post.isBottom()) return bottom();
  switch (step) {
    case Step.Assign assign -> {
       String x = assign.target().name();
       State pre = post.removeInterval(x);
       Interval xPost = post.interval(x);
       if (!xPost.isTop()) {
          RVal e = assign.source();
          LinearExpr le = toLinear(e);
          if (le != null) {
             pre = pre.applyConstraintLinear(le, xPost);
          } else {
             Interval eInt = intervalOfRVal(e, pre);
             if (eInt.disjoint(xPost)) return bottom();
             // else no refinement
          }
       }
       return pre;
    }
    case Step.Assume assume -> {
       return applyAssume(assume.cond(), post);
    }
    case Step.Call call -> {
       if (call.target().isPresent()) {
          return post.removeInterval(call.target().get().name());
       }
       return post;
    }
  }
  throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
}

State applyAssume(RVal cond, State post) {
  if (post.isBottom()) return bottom();
  if (cond instanceof RVal.Binop b && isComparison(b.op())) {
    BinOp op = b.op();
    LinearExpr le = toLinear(b.l());
    LinearExpr re = toLinear(b.r());
    if (le != null && re != null) {
      LinearExpr diff = le.sub(re);
      if (op == BinOp.Ne) {
        Interval d = diff.interval(post);
        if (d.isEmpty()) return bottom(); // should not
        if (d.isZeroSingleton()) return bottom();
        if (!d.contains(BigInteger.ZERO)) return post;
        // Could refine? For linear Ne, we could split into two states DNF but interval domain cannot. Return post.
        return post;
      } else {
        Interval target = targetInterval(op);
        return post.applyConstraintLinear(diff, target);
      }
    } else {
      Interval il = intervalOfRVal(b.l(), post);
      Interval ir = intervalOfRVal(b.r(), post);
      ComparisonDecision dec = decideComparison(il, op, ir);
      if (dec == FALSE) return bottom();
      // if TRUE or UNKNOWN return post
      return post;
    }
  } else {
    // cond may be constant or non-linear expression used as boolean
    LinearExpr le = toLinear(cond);
    if (le != null && le.isConst()) {
       return le.const().signum() == 0 ? bottom() : post;
    }
    Interval ci = intervalOfRVal(cond, post);
    // If ci definitely 0 -> bottom; if definitely 1? post; else post.
    if (ci.isSingleton() && ci.lo().signum()==0) return bottom();
    return post;
  }
}

State.applyConstraintLinear(LinearExpr expr, Interval target):
  if (isBottom()) return this;

     return expr.const().compareTo? if target.contains(expr.const()) return this; else bottomState;

  if (target.isEmpty()) return bottomState;
  for (int iter=0; iter<100; iter++) {
    boolean changed=false;

      if (ni.isEmpty()) return bottomState;
      if (!ni.equals(old)) { current = current.withInterval(var, ni); changed=true; }
    }
    if (!changed) break;
  }
  return current;
}

static Interval intervalOfRVal(RVal r, Conjunct c) {
 switch (r) {
  case RVal.IntConst ic -> return new Interval(ic.v(), ic.v());
  case LVal.Local l -> return c.interval(l.name());
  case LVal.StaticField sf -> { BigInteger v = staticValue(sf); if (v != null) return new Interval(v,v); else return c.interval(staticVarName(sf)); }
  case RVal.Binop b -> {
    BinOp op = b.op();
    switch (op) {
      case Add -> { Interval il=intervalOfRVal(b.l(),c), ir=intervalOfRVal(b.r(),c); return addInterval(il,ir); }
      case Sub -> { ... subInterval }
      case Mult -> {
         if (java.util.Objects.equals(b.l(), b.r())) return squareInterval(intervalOfRVal(b.l(), c));
         Interval il = intervalOfRVal(b.l(), c);
         Interval ir = intervalOfRVal(b.r(), c);
         if (il.isSingleton()) return ir.mulConst(il.lo());
         if (ir.isSingleton()) return il.mulConst(ir.lo());
         return il.mul(ir);
      }
      case Lt, Le, Gt, Ge, Eq, Ne -> {
         Interval il = intervalOfRVal(b.l(), c);
         Interval ir = intervalOfRVal(b.r(), c);
         return comparisonInterval(il, op, ir);
      }
    }
  }
 }
 throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
}

public Conjunct applyConstraintLinear(LinearExpr expr, Interval target) {
  if (this.isBottom()) return null;
  if (target.isTop()) return this;

  for (int iter = 0; iter < 100; iter++) {

    for (Map.Entry<String, BigInteger> e : expr.coeffs().entrySet()) {

      if (c.signum() == 0) continue;
      Interval sInt = expr.intervalExcept(current, var);

      if (ni.isEmpty()) return null;
      if (!ni.equals(old)) {
        current = current.withInterval(var, ni);
        if (current == null) return null;
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (!changed) break;
  }
  return current;
}

private static BigInteger floorDiv(BigInteger a, BigInteger b) {
  if (b.signum() == 0) throw new ArithmeticException();
  BigInteger[] qr = a.divideAndRemainder(b);

public Conjunct normalize() {
  if (isBottomRaw()) return null;
  Conjunct current = this;
  // Check constant constraints and expression interval disjoint
  for (int iter=0; iter<100; iter++) {

      if (lc.target().isTop()) continue;

    for (LinearConstraint lc : current.constraints) {
      if (lc.target().isTop()) continue;
      if (lc.expr().isConst()) continue;

        if (ni.isEmpty()) return null;
        if (!ni.equals(old)) { current = current.withIntervalRaw(var, ni); changed = true; }
      }
    }
    if (!changed) break;
  }
  // After propagation, check constraints again? The loop does at start. If changed, next iteration checks.

}

normalize algorithm more detailed:
```
public Conjunct normalize() {
  if (isBottomRaw()) return null;
  Conjunct current = this;
  for (int iter = 0; iter < 100; iter++) {
    boolean changed = false;
    // Check constraints for disjoint/constant
    for (LinearConstraint lc : current.constraints) {
      if (lc.target().isTop()) continue;
      if (lc.target().isEmpty()) return null;
      if (lc.expr().isConst()) {
        if (!lc.target().contains(lc.expr().const())) return null;
      } else {
        Interval eInt = lc.expr().interval(current);
        if (eInt.disjoint(lc.target())) return null;
      }
    }
    // Propagate
    for (LinearConstraint lc : current.constraints) {
      if (lc.target().isTop() || lc.expr().isConst()) continue;
      for (Map.Entry<String, BigInteger> e : lc.expr().coeffs().entrySet()) {
        String var = e.getKey(); BigInteger c = e.getValue();
        if (c.signum() == 0) continue;
        Interval sInt = lc.expr().intervalExcept(current, var);
        Interval cXTarget = subtractInterval(lc.target(), sInt);
        Interval xBound = divideIntervalByConst(cXTarget, c);
        if (xBound.isEmpty()) return null;
        Interval old = current.interval(var);
        Interval ni = old.intersect(xBound);
        if (ni.isEmpty()) return null;
        if (!ni.equals(old)) {
          current = current.withIntervalRaw(var, ni);
          if (current.isBottomRaw()) return null;
          changed = true;
        }
      }
    }
    if (!changed) break;
  }
  // Filter redundant constraints
  List<LinearConstraint> filtered = new ArrayList<>();
  for (LinearConstraint lc : current.constraints) {
    if (lc.target().isTop()) continue;
    if (lc.expr().isConst()) {
      if (!lc.target().contains(lc.expr().const())) return null;
      continue;
    }
    Interval eInt = lc.expr().interval(current);
    if (eInt.disjoint(lc.target())) return null;
    if (eInt.entailsInterval(lc.target())) continue;
    filtered.add(lc);
  }
  if (filtered.size() == current.constraints.size()) return current;
  return new Conjunct(current.intervals, filtered);
}
```

Transfer implementation in domain:
public State transfer(Step step, State post) {
  if (post.isBottom()) return bottom();
  switch (step) {
    case Step.Assign assign -> {
       String x = assign.target().name();
       State pre = post.removeInterval(x);
       Interval xPost = post.interval(x);
       if (!xPost.isTop()) {
          RVal e = assign.source();
          LinearExpr le = toLinear(e);
          if (le != null) {
             pre = pre.applyConstraintLinear(le, xPost);
          } else {
             Interval eInt = intervalOfRVal(e, pre);
             if (eInt.disjoint(xPost)) return bottom();
             // else no refinement
          }
       }
       return pre;
    }
    case Step.Assume assume -> {
       return applyAssume(assume.cond(), post);
    }
    case Step.Call call -> {
       if (call.target().isPresent()) {
          return post.removeInterval(call.target().get().name());
       }
       return post;
    }
  }
  throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
}

State applyAssume(RVal cond, State post) {
  if (post.isBottom()) return bottom();
  if (cond instanceof RVal.Binop b && isComparison(b.op())) {
    BinOp op = b.op();
    LinearExpr le = toLinear(b.l());
    LinearExpr re = toLinear(b.r());
    if (le != null && re != null) {
      LinearExpr diff = le.sub(re);
      if (op == BinOp.Ne) {
        Interval d = diff.interval(post);
        if (d.isEmpty()) return bottom(); // should not
        if (d.isZeroSingleton()) return bottom();
        if (!d.contains(BigInteger.ZERO)) return post;
        // Could refine? For linear Ne, we could split into two states DNF but interval domain cannot. Return post.
        return post;
      } else {
        Interval target = targetInterval(op);
        return post.applyConstraintLinear(diff, target);
      }
    } else {
      Interval il = intervalOfRVal(b.l(), post);
      Interval ir = intervalOfRVal(b.r(), post);
      ComparisonDecision dec = decideComparison(il, op, ir);
      if (dec == FALSE) return bottom();
      // if TRUE or UNKNOWN return post
      return post;
    }
  } else {
    // cond may be constant or non-linear expression used as boolean
    LinearExpr le = toLinear(cond);
    if (le != null && le.isConst()) {
       return le.const().signum() == 0 ? bottom() : post;
    }
    Interval ci = intervalOfRVal(cond, post);
    // If ci definitely 0 -> bottom; if definitely 1? post; else post.
    if (ci.isSingleton() && ci.lo().signum()==0) return bottom();
    return post;
  }
}

static Interval intervalOfRVal(RVal r, Conjunct c) {
 switch (r) {
  case RVal.IntConst ic -> return new Interval(ic.v(), ic.v());
  case LVal.Local l -> return c.interval(l.name());
  case LVal.StaticField sf -> { BigInteger v = staticValue(sf); if (v != null) return new Interval(v,v); else return c.interval(staticVarName(sf)); }
  case RVal.Binop b -> {
    BinOp op = b.op();
    switch (op) {
      case Add -> { Interval il=intervalOfRVal(b.l(),c), ir=intervalOfRVal(b.r(),c); return addInterval(il,ir); }
      case Sub -> { ... subInterval }
      case Mult -> {
         if (java.util.Objects.equals(b.l(), b.r())) return squareInterval(intervalOfRVal(b.l(), c));
         Interval il = intervalOfRVal(b.l(), c);
         Interval ir = intervalOfRVal(b.r(), c);
         if (il.isSingleton()) return ir.mulConst(il.lo());
         if (ir.isSingleton()) return il.mulConst(ir.lo());
         return il.mul(ir);
      }
      case Lt, Le, Gt, Ge, Eq, Ne -> {
         Interval il = intervalOfRVal(b.l(), c);
         Interval ir = intervalOfRVal(b.r(), c);
         return comparisonInterval(il, op, ir);
      }
    }
  }
 }
 throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
}

static final class LinearExpr {
 private final BigInteger const;
 private final Map<String, BigInteger> coeffs;
 private LinearExpr(BigInteger const, Map<String, BigInteger> coeffs) { this.const = const; this.coeffs = Map.copyOf(coeffs); }
 static LinearExpr zero() { return new LinearExpr(BigInteger.ZERO, Map.of()); }
 static LinearExpr fromConst(BigInteger v) { return new LinearExpr(v, Map.of()); }
 static LinearExpr fromVar(String v) { Map<String, BigInteger> m = new HashMap<>(); m.put(v, BigInteger.ONE); return new LinearExpr(BigInteger.ZERO, m); }
 boolean isConst() { return coeffs.isEmpty(); }
 BigInteger const() { return const; }
 Map<String, BigInteger> coeffs() { return coeffs; }
 LinearExpr add(LinearExpr o) {
   Map<String, BigInteger> m = new HashMap<>(coeffs);
   for (e : o.coeffs) m.merge(e.getKey(), e.getValue(), BigInteger::add);
   remove zero;
   return new LinearExpr(const.add(o.const), m);
 }
 LinearExpr sub(LinearExpr o) { return add(o.negate()); }
 LinearExpr negate() { Map m = new HashMap<>(); for e put -value; return new LinearExpr(const.negate(), m); }
 LinearExpr mulConst(BigInteger c) {
   if (c.signum()==0) return zero();
   if (c.signum()==1) return this;
   Map m = new HashMap<>(); for e put value.multiply(c) if nonzero;
   return new LinearExpr(const.multiply(c), m);

     Interval m = iv.mulConst(e.getValue());
     lo = addLo(lo, m.lo);
     hi = addHi(hi, m.hi);
   }
   return new Interval(lo, hi);
 }

}

private static List<Conjunct> assumeConjunct(RVal cond, Conjunct c) {
  if (c == null || c.isBottom()) return List.of();
  if (cond instanceof RVal.Binop b && isComparison(b.op())) {
    BinOp op = b.op();
    LinearExpr le = toLinear(b.l());
    LinearExpr re = toLinear(b.r());
    if (le != null && re != null) {
      LinearExpr diff = le.sub(re);
      if (op == BinOp.Ne) {
        List<Conjunct> res = new ArrayList<>();
        Conjunct low = c.applyConstraintLinear(diff, new Interval(null, ZERO.subtract(ONE))); // -1
        if (low != null) res.add(low);
        Conjunct high = c.applyConstraintLinear(diff, new Interval(ONE, null));
        if (high != null) res.add(high);
        return res;
      } else {
        Interval target = targetInterval(op);
        Conjunct r = c.applyConstraintLinear(diff, target);
        return r == null ? List.of() : List.of(r);
      }
    } else {
      Interval il = intervalOfRVal(b.l(), c);
      Interval ir = intervalOfRVal(b.r(), c);
      Decision d = decideComparison(il, op, ir);
      if (d == Decision.FALSE) return List.of();
      return List.of(c);
    }
  } else {
    LinearExpr le = toLinear(cond);
    if (le != null && le.isConst()) {
      return le.const().signum() == 0 ? List.of() : List.of(c);
    }
    Interval ci = intervalOfRVal(cond, c);
    if (ci.isSingleton() && ci.lo().signum() == 0) return List.of();
    return List.of(c);
  }
}

static State fromConjuncts(List<Conjunct> conjuncts) {
  List<Conjunct> list = new ArrayList<>();
  for (Conjunct c : conjuncts) {
    if (c == null || c.isBottom()) continue;
    if (c.isTop()) return TOP_STATE;
    list.add(c);

  if (list.isEmpty()) return BOTTOM_STATE;
  List<Conjunct> unique = new ArrayList<>();
  for (Conjunct c : list) if (!unique.contains(c)) unique.add(c);
  List<Conjunct> kept = new ArrayList<>();
  for (int i=0; i<unique.size(); i++) {
    Conjunct c = unique.get(i);
    boolean redundant = false;
    for (int j=0; j<unique.size(); j++) {
      if (i == j) continue;
      if (c.entails(unique.get(j))) { redundant = true; break; }
    }
    if (!redundant) kept.add(c);
  }
  if (kept.isEmpty()) {
    // If all were redundant due to mutual entailment (should not after unique), keep first?
    return fromConjuncts(List.of(unique.get(0)));

  if (kept.size() > DNF_LIMIT) {
    Conjunct merged = kept.get(0);
    for (int i=1; i<kept.size(); i++) {
      merged = merged.join(kept.get(i));
      if (merged == null) return BOTTOM_STATE;
    }
    return fromConjuncts(List.of(merged));
  }
  return new State(kept);
}

public Conjunct applyConstraintLinear(LinearExpr expr, Interval target) {
  if (this.isBottom()) return null;
  if (target.isTop()) return this;
  if (target.isEmpty()) return null;
  if (expr.isConst()) {
    return target.contains(expr.const()) ? this : null;
  }
  Interval eInt = expr.interval(this);
  if (eInt.disjoint(target)) return null;
  Conjunct current = this;
  for (int iter = 0; iter < 100; iter++) {
    boolean changed = false;
    for (Map.Entry<String, BigInteger> e : expr.coeffs().entrySet()) {
      String var = e.getKey();
      BigInteger c = e.getValue();
      if (c.signum() == 0) continue;
      Interval sInt = expr.intervalExcept(current, var);
      Interval cXTarget = subtractInterval(target, sInt);
      Interval xBound = divideIntervalByConst(cXTarget, c);
      if (xBound.isEmpty()) return null;
      Interval old = current.interval(var);
      Interval ni = old.intersect(xBound);
      if (ni.isEmpty()) return null;
      if (!ni.equals(old)) {
        current = current.withInterval(var, ni);
        if (current == null) return null;
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (!changed) break;
  }
  return current;
}

private static BigInteger floorDiv(BigInteger a, BigInteger b) {
  if (b.signum() == 0) throw new ArithmeticException();
  BigInteger[] qr = a.divideAndRemainder(b);
  BigInteger q = qr[0], r = qr[1];
  if (r.signum() != 0 && ((a.signum() ^ b.signum()) < 0)) q = q.subtract(ONE);

public Conjunct normalize() {
  if (isBottomRaw()) return null;
  Conjunct current = this;
  // Check constant constraints and expression interval disjoint
  for (int iter=0; iter<100; iter++) {
    boolean changed = false;
    // First, for each constraint, if expr interval under current disjoint target -> null
    for (LinearConstraint lc : current.constraints) {
      if (lc.target().isTop()) continue;
      if (lc.expr().isConst()) {
        if (!lc.target().contains(lc.expr().const())) return null;
      } else {
        Interval eInt = lc.expr().interval(current);
        if (eInt.disjoint(lc.target())) return null;
      }
    }
    // Propagate bounds from each constraint
    for (LinearConstraint lc : current.constraints) {
      if (lc.target().isTop()) continue;
      if (lc.expr().isConst()) continue;
      for (var entry : lc.expr().coeffs().entrySet()) {
        String var = entry.getKey(); BigInteger c = entry.getValue(); if c zero continue;
        Interval sInt = lc.expr().intervalExcept(current, var);
        Interval cXTarget = subtractInterval(lc.target(), sInt);
        Interval xBound = divideIntervalByConst(cXTarget, c);
        if (xBound.isEmpty()) return null;
        Interval old = current.interval(var);
        Interval ni = old.intersect(xBound);
        if (ni.isEmpty()) return null;
        if (!ni.equals(old)) { current = current.withIntervalRaw(var, ni); changed = true; }
      }
    }
    if (!changed) break;
  }
  // After propagation, check constraints again? The loop does at start. If changed, next iteration checks.
  return current;
}
```

```
public Conjunct normalize() {
  if (isBottomRaw()) return null;
  Conjunct current = this;
  for (int iter = 0; iter < 100; iter++) {
    boolean changed = false;
    // Check constraints for disjoint/constant
    for (LinearConstraint lc : current.constraints) {
      if (lc.target().isTop()) continue;
      if (lc.target().isEmpty()) return null;
      if (lc.expr().isConst()) {
        if (!lc.target().contains(lc.expr().const())) return null;
      } else {
        Interval eInt = lc.expr().interval(current);
        if (eInt.disjoint(lc.target())) return null;
      }
    }
    // Propagate
    for (LinearConstraint lc : current.constraints) {
      if (lc.target().isTop() || lc.expr().isConst()) continue;
      for (Map.Entry<String, BigInteger> e : lc.expr().coeffs().entrySet()) {
        String var = e.getKey(); BigInteger c = e.getValue();
        if (c.signum() == 0) continue;
        Interval sInt = lc.expr().intervalExcept(current, var);
        Interval cXTarget = subtractInterval(lc.target(), sInt);
        Interval xBound = divideIntervalByConst(cXTarget, c);
        if (xBound.isEmpty()) return null;
        Interval old = current.interval(var);
        Interval ni = old.intersect(xBound);
        if (ni.isEmpty()) return null;
        if (!ni.equals(old)) {
          current = current.withIntervalRaw(var, ni);
          if (current.isBottomRaw()) return null;
          changed = true;
        }
      }
    }
    if (!changed) break;
  }
  // Filter redundant constraints
  List<LinearConstraint> filtered = new ArrayList<>();
